decisions: activity-ai-lab becomes the workspace for an already saved activity
right rail remains the only fast activity entry point
journal activity title links to the analysis workspace
journal removes Open, Container and Edit buttons for activity rows
workspace implements only source activity plus basic analysis in this stage
no save-links or additional-analysis actions are implemented
Nano remains the primary parameter and typical-activity matcher
invalid individual provider items are dropped instead of failing the whole analysis
server-safe extraction covers obvious repetitions, distance, duration and mass
server fallback numeric patterns use Unicode-safe trailing boundaries; Russian and Polish sample phrases were locally exercised
provider failure degrades to safe_server_fallback instead of losing the whole basic result
no observation objects, impact profiles or facts are auto-applied
existing failed analyses are not auto-retried on page open to avoid hidden AI spend
